title: A gorgeous fireplace that is partially non-functional
text:
A gorgeous fireplace that is partially non-functional. [[VIDEOID:fc1e9bcb5d0203dbb23da4974b4c9270]] I both love and hate this fireplace. As you can see from the video and picture, it is absolutely gorgeous in white. It is also small. I am 5'5" tall and it stands a few inches below my knees. It has three settings - lights only, 750W heat, and 1500W heat. This "cat-sized" electric fireplace was everything I wanted. I also was only interested in the ambiance of the real-looking log fire made by the lights. However, the entire unit should work whether I wanted it to heat a room or not.

Set-up was easy. There is no assembly. I just took it out of the box and plugged it in after reading the manual. Reading the manual actually makes one wonder whether it should be plugged in or not because there are all sorts of overheating and fire warnings that made me nervous. Nevertheless, I tried it. The fireplace was gorgeous and realistic when lit. However, the 1500W heater would not go on. The 750W heater worked. As a result, I had my boyfriend return this as defective and decided against a replacement.

I am so disappointed but after reading the manual, some of the other reviews, and having experienced a defective unit on my first try; it is best I not get a replacement. It is too bad this is low quality. It may be truly stunning and perfectly tiny but it is operationally imperfect.

product_metadata.title: 3GPlus Free Standing Electric Fireplace Portable Heater Log Fuel Effect Realistic Flames Mini Stove, 1500W - White
